faqs.q: What are the Dixon King Crimp Style Ferrules, Zinc Plated Carbon Steel used for?
faqs.a: The Dixon King Crimp Style Ferrules, Zinc Plated Carbon Steel are crimp ferrules for 2-1/2" ID hose: the outer shell that is crimped over the hose and the coupling stem. The listing has 4 part numbers, CF250-5CS, CF250-6CS, CF250-7CS and CF250-8CS, in carbon steel with a zinc-plated finish.

faqs.q: How do I read part number CF250-7CS on the Dixon King Crimp Style Ferrules?
faqs.a: CF250-7CS is the 2-1/2 in ID carbon-steel (CS) crimp-style ferrule with a 3.121 in inside diameter. The suffix picks the inside diameter within the 2-1/2" size: -5CS is 2.996 in, -6CS is 3.059 in, -7CS is 3.121 in and -8CS is 3.184 in.

faqs.q: What sizes do the Dixon King Crimp Style Ferrules, Zinc Plated Carbon Steel come in?
faqs.a: All 4 part numbers are for 2-1/2" hose. They differ only in inside diameter, from 2.996 in for CF250-5CS to 3.184 in for CF250-8CS, so the choice is made by the outside diameter of the hose and stem you are crimping. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists them all.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right ferrule from the Dixon King Crimp Style Ferrules, Zinc Plated Carbon Steel range?
faqs.a: Choose the inside diameter by the hose and the coupling stem: the ferrule must close down onto the hose wall and the stem barb, so a hose of heavier wall takes a different inside diameter from a lighter one. Quote the hose type and size with the part number so the fitting, ferrule and crimp specification can be checked before supply.

faqs.q: What pressure are the Dixon King Crimp Style Ferrules, Zinc Plated Carbon Steel rated for?
faqs.a: The maker states 300 psi (21 bar) for these ferrules, shown against all 4 part numbers. That is the figure for the ferrule on its designed hose series; a crimp fitting is rated only on the hose series it is designed for, and the assembly is rated to its lowest-rated part.

faqs.q: What are the Dixon King Crimp Style Ferrules, Zinc Plated Carbon Steel made from?
faqs.a: The listing is zinc-plated carbon steel. Carbon steel with a zinc plating suits general industrial hose service; tell us the fluid and the environment if the hose will carry anything corrosive, and we will check the material before supply.

faqs.q: Which standards do the Dixon King Crimp Style Ferrules, Zinc Plated Carbon Steel follow?
faqs.a: The listing names no standard for the ferrule; it is a manufacturer-series crimp part for King-style 2-1/2" ID hose couplings, to be used with the hose and crimp specification it is designed for. No test certificate is attached to the listing; tell us the documents your project needs when you ask for a quotation.

faqs.q: What do the Dixon King Crimp Style Ferrules, Zinc Plated Carbon Steel fit?
faqs.a: The ferrule fits over 2-1/2" ID hose and the matching crimp-style coupling stem. A crimp fitting is rated only on the hose series it is designed for, so quote the hose type and size with the fitting part number. Related aluminium and carbon-steel crimp sleeves are listed too, such as the [Dixon King Crimp Style Sleeves, Carbon Steel](/p/dixon-king-crimp-style-sleeves-carbon-steel).

faqs.q: How are the Dixon King Crimp Style Ferrules, Zinc Plated Carbon Steel crimped?
faqs.a: The ferrule is crimped over the hose and the coupling stem with a crimping machine and the correct die for the series, to the crimp specification for that hose. A crimped ferrule is permanently deformed, so replace the assembly rather than re-crimping. See our [guide to crimp faults](/blog/hydraulic-hose-crimp-faults).

faqs.q: What is the difference between the Dixon King Crimp Style Ferrules, Zinc Plated Carbon Steel and the Dixon King Crimp Style Sleeves, Carbon Steel?
faqs.a: The Dixon King Crimp Style Ferrules, Zinc Plated Carbon Steel are ferrules, which are sold by the inside diameter of the ferrule for 2-1/2" hose, while the [Dixon King Crimp Style Sleeves, Carbon Steel](/p/dixon-king-crimp-style-sleeves-carbon-steel) are sleeves described by material and size.
